label: Supabase rows
description: Governed PostgREST row select/insert/update/upsert against Owner-allowlisted tables — Staff workflow database access without arbitrary SQL

description_i18n.en: Governed PostgREST row select/insert/update/upsert against Owner-allowlisted tables — Staff workflow database access without arbitrary SQL
description_i18n.zh_CN: 经治理的 PostgREST 行级 select/insert/update/upsert，仅限 Owner 表白名单——供 Staff 工作流当数据库用，禁止任意 SQL
description_i18n.zh_HK: 經治理的 PostgREST 列級 select/insert/update/upsert，僅限 Owner 表白名單——供 Staff 工作流當資料庫用，禁止任意 SQL

propose_guide: BEST WHEN: Staff workflow must persist or load structured business rows in the Owner Supabase project (task state, leads, research notes, config). Prefer action=select to read; insert/update/upsert only when NL explicitly asks to write. table MUST be in Owner allowed_tables. Do NOT use for web search, email, or social publish. Do NOT invent SQL or call RPC — out of scope. Empty Owner allowlist must be configured before Propose relies on this step.

propose_guide_i18n.en: BEST WHEN: Staff workflow must persist or load structured business rows in the Owner Supabase project (task state, leads, research notes, config). Prefer action=select to read; insert/update/upsert only when NL explicitly asks to write. table MUST be in Owner allowed_tables. Do NOT use for web search, email, or social publish. Do NOT invent SQL or call RPC — out of scope. Empty Owner allowlist must be configured before Propose relies on this step.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 最佳场景：Staff 工作流要在 Owner 的 Supabase 项目中读写结构化业务行（任务状态、线索、调研笔记、配置）。读用 action=select；仅当用户明确要求写入时用 insert/update/upsert。table 必须在 Owner allowed_tables 内。不要用于网页搜索、发信、发帖。不要编造 SQL 或调用 RPC。Owner 未配置表白名单前不要依赖本步骤。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 最佳場景：Staff 工作流要在 Owner 的 Supabase 專案中讀寫結構化業務列（任務狀態、線索、調研筆記、配置）。讀用 action=select；僅當用戶明確要求寫入時用 insert/update/upsert。table 必須在 Owner allowed_tables 內。不要用於網頁搜尋、發信、發帖。不要編造 SQL 或呼叫 RPC。Owner 未配置表白名單前不要依賴本步驟。

table.description: Table name in Vault schema (public by default); allowlisted by Owner

params.name: action
params.propose_hint: Default to select unless NL clearly asks to write rows.

allowed_tables.label: Allowed tables
allowed_tables.description: Only these table names may be accessed. Empty list denies all tables (configure before use).

max_rows.label: Max select rows
max_rows.description: Hard cap for select limit (platform/Track B).

require_human_on_read.label: Require human on select
require_human_on_read.description: When true, select also intercepts for human approval.
